moments.title: FA Community Shield This Weekend

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean Hold UK #1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' remains at number one on the Official UK Singles Chart for an incredible 20th non-consecutive week.

angles.name: Chart domination
angles.copy: Still unstoppable! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' makes it 20 weeks at UK Number 1. What a track!

angles.name: Longest running #1
angles.copy: History maker! 'Rein Me In' by Sam Fender & Olivia Dean is now the longest-running UK Number 1 single of all time. Are you still streaming it?

moments.title: Ariana Grande's New Chart Success
moments.blurb: Ariana Grande has two new entries in the Official UK Singles Chart Top 10 this week: 'Petal' at #4 and 'Hate That I Made You Love Me' at #3.

angles.name: Ariana takes over
angles.copy: Two new Top 10 entries for Ariana Grande this week! 'Petal' and 'Hate That I Made You Love Me' are climbing fast on the UK Singles Chart.

angles.name: Chart double
angles.copy: Ariana Grande hitting the UK Top 10 TWICE with 'Petal' and 'Hate That I Made You Love Me'! Which is your favourite?
